title: Dinner at B-212 — a SETU Food walkthrough
angle:
STORY-FIRST: one evening with Aarav (Nehru Hall of Residence, room B-212). Tonight he signs in on his phone. Password is the main way in; tonight he uses the emailed one-time code, shown with a DEMO label. We then step aside to show how a first-timer sets up, which is how his 'Home · B-212' address was saved. After that we follow one unbroken dinner order: 1 × Masala Dosa + 2 × Filter Coffee from Southside Tiffins. Aarav pays ₹150 straight to the stall in cash at his door, his handover code completes the order, and he rates it. Every step is taught inside the story, and the stall-QR route is a clearly labelled side branch. The owner's scene order is kept. Onboarding steps 3–4 sit right after the location step because location is step 2 of the app's real 4-step onboarding. Tone: warm, plain, lightly playful ('Tonight: dosa.' / 'Dinner, sorted.'), with no hype and no jargon. 'Students, faculty, staff' is said once. Motif: the real campus-boundary polygon with a Nehru Hall pin opens the film, returns as the delivery-area check on the map, becomes Aarav's address card, and closes the end card.
GLOBAL SYSTEM (every scene): 1920×1080, 60 fps, seekable paused GSAP timelines using the hyperframes kit.js helpers (tap, ring, layer, swapPush/swapBack/swapSheet/swapFade, focus/unfocus, drawPath, callout, revealWords).
Canvas: radial #22307A (centre-right) → #151E4D → #0C1233 at the edges, with one restrained #2E5BEE glow (≤18%) behind the phone. No particles.
Phone: kit .phone with the real 390×844 screen. Default spec is {left:1262, top:70, k:1.08} (screen ≈ x1276–1697, y84–995).
Camera: kit focus() on a rig that holds the device and its overlays only. The left-column type and the captions sit outside the rig. Focused points land near canvas (1480,500). Push-ins are 1.2–1.8×, with a hard cap of 2.5×.
Left column (x140–1000): kicker (Space Mono 700 22 px caps, .2em, orange 34 px dash) at y≈200, plus an optional short headline in Sora 800, 64–86 px, accent #B8C7FF.
CAPTIONS: fixed top layer. Bottom-left plate: left x140, bottom edge ≤1026, max-width 1040 px. The plate is centred at x960 only in s12. Plus Jakarta Sans 600 40 px/1.28, white on rgba(12,18,51,.78), radius 14, padding 14/24. In/out: 0.18 s fade + 6 px rise. A caption never sits over a phone screen. A line break in a caption's text is the intended break.
OVERLAYS:
- Taps: kit tap() at the centre of the named mark, 0.25–0.45 s before the screen change it causes.
- Rings: orange = look here; ring--blue = next tap target; the green #19B36B variant is used only for 'within delivery area' and for payment or handover confirmations.
- Callouts: a white pill holds an exact UI quote in curly quotes; a dark pill holds our own label. Leader lines are 2 px pale.
MOTION:
- Arrivals: expo.out, 0.5–0.8 s. Camera moves: expo.inOut, 0.6–0.9 s. Fades: power2. back.out(1.6) is used only on callouts.
- Screen changes: swapPush = forward navigation (0.5–0.6 s), swapBack = back, swapSheet = sheets, swapFade 0.12–0.35 s = in-place state changes.
- Frame sequences: typing plays at 25–40 fps, scrolls at 60 fps.
Icons are Lucide-style line icons (2 px) only. No emoji, clip-art or food photos: appetite comes from the real dish names and prices set large (names in Plus Jakarta Sans 700, prices in Space Mono 700).
Coordinates: mark boxes are CSS px of the 390×844 screen, from each capture's .json (x,y,w×h). Boxes tagged (PNG) were measured on the final PNGs because no mark exists.

- signin/07-home.png reads 'Set your delivery location / Tap to pick it on the map' (fresh device). Add no claim about it.
- The audience line comes from the facts (students, faculty and staff with IIT Kharagpur campus accounts). The UI pill reads 'IIT KHARAGPUR CAMPUS ACCOUNTS ONLY'.
